title: Dragonnor's Breath
description:
The rumble of a hissing volcano rises in your chest.

You breathe a 4.5 m cone of flame. Each creature in the cone makes a {{sauvegarde}} ({{dexterite}} + {{reflexes}}) against your {{dd}} (10 + {{constitution}} + {{visee}}). On a failure, it takes {{4d8 degats-feu}}. On a success, it takes only half.
